embeds.title: ARTICLE I — LEAGUE IDENTITY AND PURPOSE
embeds.description:
The **Beer League Hockey Association (BLHA)** is a 12-franchise dynasty fantasy hockey league built around long-term roster construction, prospect development, active trading, daily competition, and permanent league history.

**Fantrax** is the authoritative platform for gameplay, rosters, scoring, transactions, standings, and playoff results.

**Discord** is the league’s communication, governance, trade-market, scouting, recordkeeping, and community platform.
